board.dmgMon.unknownSpecies.what: candidate scorings where the damage engine could not identify a Pokemon, so every damage-derived feature silently read zero
board.dmgMon.unknownSpecies.target_note: A CEILING IS NOT AN ACCEPTABLE STATE. 8.42% is what the code does today, recorded so it cannot get worse. Of the 7 species still unresolvable on real sheets, 67 of 69 occurrences are COSMETIC formes -- Sinistcha-Masterpiece, Maushold-Four, four Vivillon patterns -- which have identical base stats AND identical types to their base species, so falling back to the base is provably harmless for damage. Gourgeist-Super (stats differ) and any regional forme (stats and types differ) must NOT fall back. That rule is derivable from the dex and is the specified next fix; it should bring this under 0.1%.
